sloka: पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च दिशश्च प्रदिशस्तथा ।प्राकम्पयत्तदा शब्दो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दारुणः ।। ६.१०४.१५ ।।
transliteration: pṛthivīṁ cāntarikṣaṁ ca diśaśca pradiśastathā ।prākampayattadā śabdo rākṣasendrasya dāruṇaḥ ।। 6.104.15 ।।

translations.english: By the horrible sound made by the Rakshasa king, the earth, even the heavens, similarly the quarters and corners trembled.
